title: US seeks stronger economic ties with PH to match defense alliance

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The United States (US) wants to strengthen its economic partnership with the Philippines to match their long-standing defense alliance, US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton said on Monday. In a statement, Lipton said Washington supports the Philippines’ economic development and believes that stronger economic cooperation should complement the two countries’ security partnership.
